hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: In the dimly lit scullery, I found myself face-to-face with the newest arrival, Betty Ryal. My heart fluttered as she gingerly took a bite of the bread, her eyes wide with curiosity. I couldn't help but notice the way she clutched the loaf close to her, as if it were her last meal. It was then that I realized she needed assistance. I reached out, and she allowed me to help lace her stays before the grand ball. What secrets might she hold beneath those stays?
caption:
A quiet moment that turned into a grand adventure. 🌟
